web.title: Tuai: claim FoldingCash rewards

banner.note: New project, first commit after the 14 November start
banner.firstCommit: First commit {commit} in the source repository

web.intro: Enter the Bitcoin Cash address you fold for. This page finds your leaf in the published epoch file, checks its proof in your browser, and compares the root with the one the pool contract holds on chain.
web.addressHint: With or without the prefix. Token-aware (z) and ordinary (q) addresses find the same leaf.
web.checking: Reading the chain and the epoch file

error.invalid: That is not a valid CashAddr. Check for a missing or extra character.
error.wrongNetwork: This is a {prefix} address. This page shows {network}; use an address that starts with {expected}.
error.notFound: No leaf for this address in epoch {epoch}. Rewards appear here once an epoch that includes the address is published.
error.badProof: The proof for this leaf is malformed. Do not claim from this file.
error.chain: Could not read the chain from {server} ({reason}). Nothing was checked; try again.
error.epochMissing: The pool holds epoch {epoch} on chain, but this site has no file for it yet.
error.files: Could not load the published epoch files ({reason}).

result.heading: Your rewards in epoch {epoch}
result.allClaimed: Everything earned so far has been claimed.

proof.heading: Proof, checked in this browser
proof.left: your branch is on the left
proof.right: your branch is on the right
proof.chainRoot: Root the pool contract holds, epoch {epoch}
proof.match: The proof leads to the root the pool contract holds. A claim with this proof will pay.
proof.fileMismatch: The proof does not lead to the root in the epoch file. Do not claim from this file.
proof.rootMismatch: Root mismatch: the epoch file has {fileRoot} for epoch {fileEpoch}, but the pool contract holds {chainRoot} for epoch {chainEpoch}. Do not trust these amounts until the matching file is published.

gate.heading: Root updates
gate.waiting: Epoch {epoch} is in its audit window: {blocks} blocks left before anyone can activate it.
gate.ready: Epoch {epoch} has passed its audit window. Anyone can activate it now.
gate.unconfirmed: Epoch {epoch} has been proposed and is not in a block yet.
gate.window: A new root becomes claimable {blocks} blocks after two of three operators propose it (a short window for this demonstration). In production the window is {production} blocks, about one day.

claim.heading: Claim
claim.text: Anyone can submit the claim and pay its fee; the tokens always go to the address in the leaf. Run this from a clone of the repository:
claim.copyFailed: Select the command and copy it by hand.

activity.heading: Every transaction on {network}
activity.intro: Each step of the demonstration as it was sent, in order, including the ones the node refused. This page asks the Electrum server {server} about every listed transaction itself and shows the answer under it. Links open the transaction in a block explorer.
activity.failed: Could not load the transaction record ({reason}).
activity.empty: No transactions are recorded for {network} yet.

relay.heading: Claim from this page
relay.text: On chipnet, a demo relayer pays the fee and dust from its own test coins. The contract sends the tokens only to the address in the leaf, so the relayer cannot move them anywhere else.
relay.button: Claim now, fee paid by the demo relayer (chipnet)
relay.working: Building and sending the claim. This can take up to a minute.
relay.againText: This address has claimed everything it earned so far. Try to claim the same amount a second time: the contract refuses it, and the answers are shown here.
relay.againWorking: Sending a second claim for the same amount.
relay.off: The demo relayer is not available ({reason}). Use the command below instead.
relay.low: About {n} claims left before the demo relayer runs out of test coins.

dry.lowBalance: The demo relayer has run out of test coins, so this button is off for now.
dry.off: The demo relayer is switched off, so this button is off for now.
dry.why: The relayer is only a convenience for this demo. Your claim does not depend on it: the pool pays the address in your leaf, whoever sends the transaction.
dry.todo: Claim with the command below, paying the fee from your own chipnet test coins, or try this button again later.

walletClaim.heading: Claim with your own wallet
walletClaim.text: Connect a WizardConnect wallet on {network}. This server prepares the claim, this page checks every input and output, and your wallet signs and pays the fee and dust. The contract still sends the tokens only to the address in the leaf.
walletClaim.scan: Scan this code with a WizardConnect wallet, or open the link on the device that has the wallet.
walletClaim.preparing: Connected to {wallet}. Preparing the claim from your wallet's {network} coins.
walletClaim.searching: Connected to {wallet}. Searching your wallet's {network} addresses for coins.
walletClaim.noCoins: No {network} coins were found on the first {receive} receive and {change} change addresses of this wallet (the search stops after {gap} unused addresses in a row).
walletClaim.withoutWallet: You can claim without a wallet: press Claim now on this card, where the demo relayer pays the fee, or run the claim from a clone of the repository.
walletClaim.noKeys: the wallet shared no receive or change keys
walletClaim.approve: Approve in your wallet. It pays {sats} satoshis of fee and dust; {amount} tokens go to the leaf address.
walletClaim.refused: This page refused the prepared transaction and did not send it to your wallet: {reason}
walletClaim.failed: The wallet claim did not finish: {message}

hero.costPull: Pull: {sats} sat per epoch for the operator, however many folders there are (measured propose and activate).
